title: traffic-speed-homography: vehicle speed estimation from traffic video with perspective correction
description: Code for vehicle speed estimation from recorded traffic footage, using object detection, tracking, polygon-zone mapping and homography-based perspective correction with OpenCV. Accompanies the manuscript 'Enhancing Vehicle Speed Estimation Accuracy Using Computer Vision' (Isogun and Agagu).
